bends.note: angle point: straight N-S from St Clair through Rochelle to here, then slants SSE (dx/dy ~0.13) to University, where it meets ~340 px east of the south leg

notes: Printed names: 'W. ST. CLAIR', 'W. ROCHELLE', 'W. UNIVERSITY AV.', 'SCIOTO', 'FOUNTAIN' (stub north of St Clair at the left edge), 'POWHATAN (JOHNSTON)' (old name Johnston), 'GRAEFF', 'ANDY', 'JEFFERSON AV.', 'FALKE', 'GLENDORA AV.', 'VINE'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Scioto lies on the binding at the left edge (east kerb at x~335-340, centre ~150-155 just on the paper); the same crossings are on 265 and 264. Powhatan and Graeff run St Clair-Rochelle only; Andy starts at Rochelle and runs south, ~450 px east of Powhatan. Jefferson Av runs straight N-S from St Clair south; north of St Clair the street labelled JEFFERSON AV. (with the 10-inch main) leaves St Clair ~530 px further east and slants NNW onto 268, recorded as 'Jefferson Avenue (north of St. Clair)'; its line continues SE across St Clair as a 'PRIVATE WAY' through block 4 (not recorded). Falke: the 60 ft street labelled FALKE runs St Clair-Rochelle-University ('Falke Street (north of University)', same name used on 264) and the 40 ft leg south of University ('Falke Street') is offset ~340 px west. At St Clair, Glendora Av (50 ft, slanting NNW onto 268) meets ~100 px east of Falke's centreline, so they are two T's (centre extrapolated from the kerbs). Vine is 90 ft; east of Vine is 'See Volume Four' with openings at St Clair, Rochelle and University (recorded as crossings); north of St Clair Vine's east kerb slants NW (onto 268).
